title: A button that presses in
summary: Transition transform and box-shadow together so :hover raises the button and :active pushes it down.
explanation: The transition is declared once on .btn, listing the properties to animate: transform and box-shadow over 120ms. Every state then only says where to end up. :hover moves it up 2px with a bigger shadow, :active moves it down 1px with almost no shadow, so it feels like a physical key.
Short durations (100 to 200ms) suit buttons: long enough to see, short enough never to slow anyone down.
List specific properties instead of transition: all. all also animates things you did not mean to, such as a colour change from a theme switch, and can make the page feel sluggish.
tryThis: Hover the button, then press and hold it.
Change 120ms to 600ms: the press feels slow and mushy.
Remove box-shadow from the transition list: the shadow jumps while the button glides.
